Sandbox_HARMONIE_ProtectionDamageMultipl: Multiplies how much condition Standardized Vehicle Upgrades 3's own protection/armor parts (bullbars, window/door/trunk armor, wheel chains) lose each time they absorb damage for the vehicle part they protect. 1.0 = SVU3's own unmodified values. Higher = they break down faster from use.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_VehicleTierScaling_tool: Cars SVU3 can upgrade are ranked by weight, front/rear end strength, seats and trunk size, and split into 3 tiers (1 = smallest). Each tier has a highest level for the main skill of an upgrade and for its other skills (the options below). SVU3's hardest upgrade (the plow) needs exactly those levels; easier upgrades need proportionally less. The tiers are listed in console.txt when the game starts. Off = SVU3's own levels for every car.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_Tier1MainSkill_tooltip: Highest level of an upgrade's main skill (the one it needs most, usually Metalworking) on tier 1 cars. Default 4.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_Tier1SecondSkill_toolti: Highest level of an upgrade's other skills (usually Mechanics) on tier 1 cars. Default 2.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_Tier2MainSkill_tooltip: Highest level of an upgrade's main skill (the one it needs most, usually Metalworking) on tier 2 cars. Default 6.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_Tier2SecondSkill_toolti: Highest level of an upgrade's other skills (usually Mechanics) on tier 2 cars. Default 4.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_Tier3MainSkill_tooltip: Highest level of an upgrade's main skill (the one it needs most, usually Metalworking) on tier 3 cars. Default 8.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_Tier3SecondSkill_toolti: Highest level of an upgrade's other skills (usually Mechanics) on tier 3 cars. Default 6.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_VehicleTierOverrides_to: Put cars in a tier yourself, by their vehicle script name: name=tier, separated by ; (e.g. Van*=2; StepVan=3). A * at the end means every name that starts so (Van* = Van, VanAmbulance, Van_Glass...). An exact name wins over a * one. The names are listed in console.txt. none = no hand-set tiers.
